@@U04446@@
And don’t ask How, ask What.
If I’ve learned one thing at sea,
it’s the sailor's Holy Trinity.
War, Trade, and Piracy,
a three-in-one, a one-in-three.

@@U04448@@
What's this, no thanks, no greetings?
You'd think, looking at him,
we brought back garbage.
Look at him, screwing his face!
He thinks it stinks?

@@U04450@@
You've had your share!
You wont be getting more!

@@U04452@@
But that was only to pass the time.
We demand our equal share.

@@U04454@@
First, then, you'll have to arrange it room by room,
treasure upon treasure—spare nothing.
Once he’s dazzled by the wealth of it all,
he'll see reason,
he'll calculate it piece by piece,
and give the fleet a whole daisy chain of parties,
you'll see. Besides,
the chippies arrive tomorrow.
Rest easy, you'll all be well provided.

@@U04455@@
(The cargo is removed.)

@@U04457@@
(To 浮士德.)

@@U04458@@
Why is it when I speak of your great good fortune
you meet it with gloom and despair?
What more can you ask?
Your wise plan has triumphed!
translation:
@@U04446@@
不要问如何，而要问什么。
如果我在海上学到了一件事，
这是水手的神圣三位一体。
战争、贸易和海盗，
三合一，三合一。

@@U04448@@
这是什么，没有谢谢，没有问候？
看着他，你会想，
我们带回了垃圾。
瞧他那张脸，还扭捏着呢！
他觉得臭吗？

@@U04450@@
你已经得到了你的那一份！
你不会得到更多！

@@U04452@@
但这只是为了打发时间。
我们要求平等的份额。

@@U04454@@
那么首先你得一个房间一个房间地安排
宝物上的宝物——不遗余力。
一旦他被这一切的财富弄得眼花缭乱，
他会明白道理，
他会一点一点地计算，
并为舰队提供一整套各方菊花链，
你会看到的。此外，
薯条明天到。
放心吧，你们都会得到很好的照顾。

@@U04455@@
（货物已被移走。）

@@U04457@@
（致浮士德。）

@@U04458@@
为什么当我谈到你的巨大福气时
你会带着忧郁和绝望面对它吗？
你还能问什么？
你明智的计划胜利了！
